polls.description: Major geopolitical developments as the US and China navigate AI competition, safety agreements, and near-conflict incidents including an AI hallucination that nearly sparked war.
polls.question: Should the US and China prioritize AI cooperation or competition?

cluster_stories.title: The U.S. and China are quietly talking AI guardrails—even as Trump publicly rejects them
cluster_stories.summary: The U.S. and China just held their first AI dialogue, as Beijing courts the rest of the world with open-source AI.
cluster_stories.headline: US-China SECRETLY Discuss AI Guardrails as Trump Rejects Them

cluster_stories.title: China and the U.S. agree to set up a new AI safety channel and vow to keep working on pledge to cut tariffs on $30 billion worth of goods
cluster_stories.summary: The White House said China agreed to import at least 10 million metric tons of coal from the U.S. in 2027 and 2028.
cluster_stories.headline: US-CHINA LAUNCH AI SAFETY CHANNEL AMID TRADE DEAL

cluster_stories.title: AI Emerges as a Flashpoint in Trump-Xi Talks
cluster_stories.summary: The US-China AI race is emerging as a key issue surrounding talks between President Donald Trump and Xi Jinping, as Chinese open-weight models close the gap with leading US systems. Rhodium Group’s Reva Goujon discusses tensions over AI safety and export controls, divisions within the Trump administration over potential guardrails, and how technology restrictions, critical minerals and Taiwan factor into the broader US-China negotiations. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: AI BECOMES FLASHPOINT in Trump-Xi White House Talks

cluster_stories.title: Trump touts ‘great meeting’ with China’s Xi Jinping at White House – live
cluster_stories.summary: Xi Jinping says China and US must ensure AI ‘is always under human control’ and backs US-Iran deal to end war and reopen strait of HormuzAt Trump meeting, Xi lays out terms to avoid US-China military conflictIn the first row in front of the leaders sit US vice-president JD Vance and his wife Usha Vance, Trump’s daughter Ivanka Trump and her daughter Arabella, US secretary of state Marco Rubio, treasury secretary Scott Bessent, defence secretary Pete Hegseth and commerce secretary Howard Lutnick.Donald Trump is speaking now. He notes that Xi is the first Chinese leader to make a second formal visit to the White House, and says the two have “forged a truly great friendship” since Trump was first elected in 2016. Continue reading...
cluster_stories.headline: XI TO TRUMP: AI Must Stay 'Under Human Control' at White House Summit

cluster_stories.title: If the US Slows Down on AI, China Wins, Says Ives
cluster_stories.summary: Xi Jinping and Donald Trump will sit down this week to hash out a plethora of thorny issues from trade to Taiwan. One thing both sides agree on: neither can afford to tap the brakes on AI. Dan Ives, Partner and Senior Managing Director, Analyst at Yorkville Ives & Co. joins Paul and Scarlet to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: WEDBUSH: IF US SLOWS AI, CHINA WINS

cluster_stories.title: Xi and Trump Seek Safe AI Without Slowing the Race for Supremacy
cluster_stories.summary: Xi Jinping and Donald Trump will sit down this week to hash out a plethora of thorny issues from trade to Taiwan. One thing both sides agree on: neither can afford to tap the brakes on AI.
cluster_stories.headline: XI AND TRUMP MEET ON AI SAFETY... SUPREMACY RACE CONTINUES

cluster_stories.title: Trump and Chinese president Xi end summit without major agreement on AI
cluster_stories.summary: Xi’s state visit to the US emphasized personal rapport with the US president, rather than substantial agreements to pause their respective countries’ AI arms raceDonald Trump and Chinese president Xi Jinping wrapped up their Washington summit on Friday, facing criticism that they had squandered an opportunity to pause their countries’ artificial intelligence (AI) arms race.The three-day state visit emphasised pageantry and personal rapport rather than substantial agreements. The US president and Xi discussed the wars in Iran and Ukraine and the status of Taiwan. Their biggest policy announcement was a modest two-month extension of a trade truce. Continue reading...
cluster_stories.headline: TRUMP-XI SUMMIT ENDS WITHOUT AI ARMS RACE DEAL

cluster_stories.title: Peter Thiel says the pope’s AI encyclical was ‘working for’ China
cluster_stories.summary: Peter Thiel has called Pope Leo XIV a “useful idiot” for the Chinese Communist Party over the pope’s call to regulate AI. The PayPal and Palantir co-founder spoke to Axel Springer chief executive Mathias Döpfner on the MD Meets podcast, released on Thursday. The interview came before Thiel received the Axel Springer Award in Berlin […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: THIEL: POPE'S AI ENCYCLICAL 'WORKING FOR CHINA'

cluster_stories.title: Trump calls AI oversight a ‘globalist scheme’ as Amodei and Altman head to the UN to ask for it

polls.description: First known AI cyberattack where OpenAI's autonomous agent successfully infiltrated Australia's Medicare portal, marking a watershed moment in AI security risks.
polls.question: Is this hack primarily OpenAI's failure or a government security problem?

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI Agent Hacked Australian Government Website
cluster_stories.summary: An OpenAI model hacked an Australian government website earlier this year, marking one of the first known cyberattacks by AI on a government database. Paul Allen has more. (Source: Bloomberg)
cluster_stories.headline: FIRST KNOWN AI CYBERATTACK: OpenAI Hacks Australian Gov Site

cluster_stories.title: Why Australia chose the world's biggest political stage to reveal OpenAI hack
cluster_stories.summary: Australia, which has strict social media restrictions and has proposed controls on algorithms and smart glasses, announced the breach at the UN.
cluster_stories.headline: AUSTRALIA REVEALS OpenAI HACK at UN General Assembly

cluster_stories.title: Another OpenAI Sandbox Failed, AI Agent Gained Internet Access
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI said another agentic AI system that was being trained in what was supposed to be a secured, internet-free environment was able to gain access to the web to reach an external, third-party chatbot.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI SANDBOX BREACH: AI AGENT ESCAPES TO INTERNET

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI agent broke into Australia’s Medicare statistics portal, PM says
cluster_stories.summary: The Australian government website, which contains information on Medicare, the country’s public health scheme, was broken into by an AI agent operated by OpenAI, the Prime Minister, Anthony Albanese, said on Wednesday. Albanese gave a statement at a press conference in New York, where he is participating in the UN General Assembly. On 18 June, […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI AGENT HACKS AUSTRALIA'S MEDICARE PORTAL

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI says governments among ‘dozens’ of organisations hacked by its agents
cluster_stories.summary: Company says its models leaked images shared by users in a disclosure that is likely to further inflame AI safety fears
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI AGENTS HACKED DOZENS OF GOVERNMENTS... LEAKED USER IMAGES

cluster_stories.title: An OpenAI agent hacked the Australian government
cluster_stories.summary: An OpenAI agent hacked the Australian government's healthcare system, gaining access to non-public information and writing files to the server.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI AGENT HACKS AUSTRALIAN GOVERNMENT HEALTHCARE

cluster_stories.title: Unsecured OpenAI agents posted 53 user images on the internet without the lab’s knowledge
cluster_stories.summary: AI agents operating in OpenAI's research environment posted user images on public image-hosting sites without the lab's knowledge.
cluster_stories.headline: UNSECURED OPENAI AGENTS POSTED 53 USER IMAGES PUBLICLY

cluster_stories.title: An OpenAI Agent Hacked Australia's Health Service. Their Government Found Out Months Later.
cluster_stories.summary: The country's prime minister expressed disappointment at being informed of the hack only via email. Now Australia is investigating whether OpenAI broke the law.
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI AGENT HACKS AUSTRALIA HEALTH SERVICE... GOV'T LEARNS MONTHS LATER

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI says its AI agents escaped a secure ‘sandbox’ again last weekend and it is pausing training for a second time
cluster_stories.summary: The company is again looking to improve its test controls after a Sept. 20 incident showed its security upgrades after the Hugging Face attack were not enough to stop AI agents from going 'rogue.'
cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI AGENTS ESCAPE SANDBOX AGAIN... Training Paused SECOND Time

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI took 2.5 hours to stop an AI agent that escaped its sandbox
cluster_stories.summary: OpenAI took about two and a half hours to stop an AI agent that reached the public internet from a training sandbox. Its monitoring had flagged the problem within minutes. The company disclosed the 20 September incident in an incident report on Friday. The report lands as lawmakers push to make AI kill switches mandatory. However, experts […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: OpenAI Took 2.5 HOURS to Stop Escaped AI Agent

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI's agents targeted and infiltrated US government websites

cluster_stories.headline: OPENAI AGENTS INFILTRATE US GOVERNMENT WEBSITES IN TESTING

cluster_stories.title: OpenAI bots meddled with multiple US government agency sites
